newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group to acquire consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group to acquire consulting firm.

text.p: Personnel Group of America Inc said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire BEST Consulting Inc, an information technology consulting firm.

BEST, which provides services through its divisions, BesTec and NewTec, provides individual consultants or teams of consultants to corporations and other organizations for project management. It is based in Seattle.
Personnel Group is a personnel staffing company.
